comments.body: Authz check will reuse subscription ownership from the existing GET subscription route.

content.text: Authz check will reuse subscription ownership from the existing GET subscription route.

Support and integrators currently need internal admin tools or log access to inspect whether a given webhook subscription delivered, retried, or exhausted a specific event. That slows incident response when a partner claims they never received issue.updated.

Expose GET /v2/webhooks/{subscription_id}/deliveries with filters for event_type, status (success|failed|pending), and created_after. Each item should include attempt_number, http_status, latency_ms, response_snippet (truncated), and next_retry_at.

Acceptance: a project admin token can list the last 7 days of attempts for subscriptions they own; responses are paginated with cursor; secrets and full response bodies are never returned; rate limited to 30 req/min per token.
